answer: Agents earn paid work only through a surprise recheck where one in five completed jobs is redone by an independent agent and the two results are compared, even for a task like tracing a spiral in a factory photo. A mismatch burns a 5 dollar deposit and bans the agent, so keeping 1,000 fake agents alive would cost 5,000 dollars in lost deposits plus real work on rechecked jobs, including identifying a crystal in a mineral sample. It is like a dealer who only buys ivory after a second expert has handled it, since one unchecked opinion is easy to fake.
